question:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

While some people may face legitimate obstacles, others are just __obstinate__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **obedient**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"obstinate"** means stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion or chosen course of action, despite attempts to persuade one to do so. (हठी)

 
 
• **Example: **Despite numerous discussions, he remained obstinate about his decision to move abroad.
 
 
 
• **"Obedient" **refers to someone who is willing to comply with orders or requests; submissive to another's authority. (आज्ञाकारी)
 
 
• **Example: **The obedient child quickly followed his parent's instructions without any argument.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'obstinate' **is **'obedient'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 i.e. obedient**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Firm **(दृढ़): Having a solid, almost unyielding surface or structure.

 
 
• **Example:** He gave a firm handshake to convey confidence.
 
 
 
• **Dogged **(दृढ़ निश्चयी): Having or showing tenacity and grim persistence.
 
 
• **Example: **Her dogged determination helped her overcome many obstacles.
 
 
 
• **Stubborn** (जिद्दी): Having or showing dogged determination not to change one's attitude or position on something.
 
 
• **Example:** The stubborn mule refused to move an inch.
